english.title: Permit the trade use of weighing / measuring equipment not conforming to a variation / revocation of specification
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to use for trade

(A)_[weighing]_
(B)_[measuring]_

equipment which had conformed to a specification prescribed by regulations under section 14 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 but which, following

(C)_[variation]_
(D)_[revocation]_

by further regulations under the section, to your knowledge no longer conformed with a prescribed specification, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SPECIFICATION..), in that **(..SPECIFY THE NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 14(3)(c) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.

english.notes:
(i) Section 14(3) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that the any equipment in respect of which the offence was committed shall be liable to be forfeited.
(ii) Section 83(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
